method: Public contract and independently authored receiver were frozen before candidate source body or execution. Original and candidate actual CLI courses were then run once; source review followed candidate receiving. This seal only rechecks retained records and bytes.
source_findings: explorer.py adds only the optional replay flag and lazy dispatch. Removing the reviewed 282-byte addition restores the original 7141-byte body; default replay and HTTP paths are unchanged.
Explain-only reading opens a regular file, performs an actual MAX+1 bounded read, parses UTF-8 and rejects nonfinite JSON numbers including overflow. The original decoder remains unchanged.

The deterministic difference walk uses sorted object keys and array indices, RFC 6901 escaping, explicit missing/null/type/value envelopes, and the original boolean-sensitive numeric equivalence. It stops after witnessing the thirty-third difference and reports only the first thirty-two.
JSON output is prepared before writing, write counts and flushing are checked, and failures return 2. A failed output operation may already have emitted partial bytes.
Existing engine and scenario source bytes/modes are unchanged. The new guide accurately separates field differences from causal explanation, provenance or operational authority.
receiving_findings: All four ordinary export/replay command outputs, stderr and exit codes match the original byte for byte.

Actual candidate CLI checks cover one-field and ordered seven-field changes, Unicode pointer escaping, missing/null/type distinctions, finite numeric equivalence, rejected-but-reproducible fixtures, 32 versus 33 differences, explicit correction after invalid input, invalid UTF-8/nonfinite/overflow/oversized inputs, byte determinism and /dev/full failure.

All source names, bytes and modes and receiving controls were preserved. Every command includes an input preservation comparison. The harness explicitly corrects one owned invalid fixture between commands.
All 48 retained streams exactly match the receipts' inline fields under strict UTF-8 decoding and re-encoding; all 120 declared checks recompute from their retained literal actual/expected values.
scope: Cloud Python CLI and source review only; author native receiving is independently recorded by Anvil.
No browser replay, live service installation, provider/model invocation or operational-aircraft claim.
No new product run during sealing; author tests are not counted as root receiving.
The public --explain input cap and ordinary default decoder behavior intentionally differ; validation is scoped accordingly.
cross_review: Anvil independently read the frozen receiver, both receipts and all 48 raw streams before publication; no optional product rerun requested.
